edition.authority: Second Vatican Council; Doctrinal Commission; Secretary General Pericle Felici
edition.notes: The one-page Latin notification includes the question and Doctrinal Commission response, reproduces the Commission's declaration of 6 March 1964, and reports the higher authority's communication of the separately titled Nota explicativa praevia.
edition.title: Notificationes

passages.context: The complete notification delivered on 16 November 1964, including the question about theological qualification, the Doctrinal Commission's response, its reproduced 6 March declaration, and the communication introducing the separate preliminary note.
passages.notes: The complete passage ends before the Nota explicativa praevia heading on the same artifact page.

alternate_titles: Notificationes given by the Secretary General of the Council at the 123rd General Congregation
work.author: Second Vatican Council
work.description: The notification delivered by the Council's Secretary General at the 123rd General Congregation on 16 November 1964 concerning the theological qualification and interpretation of the teaching in the schema De Ecclesia. It reproduces the Doctrinal Commission's declaration of 6 March 1964 and precedes the separately titled Nota explicativa praevia.
work.title: Notificationes
